scope: Sixteen main body lines, excluding the supralinear insertion and clear signature. Provisional, not a verified transcript.

labels.X: two-bar cross; capital initial and smaller instances tentatively grouped
labels.H: two uprights joined across the middle
labels.T: sideways T with horizontal stroke at middle height
labels.D: quaver-like upright and bottom loop; frequently doubled
labels.E: e-like small curve; CE may be one compound glyph
labels.K: h-like upright with lower right curve
labels.R: long stem with two crossbars and curved bottom
labels.+: simple cross, provisionally distinct from A
labels.W: broad angular backward-five form, introduced in lines 4–6
labels.G: large C-like open curve, distinct from small c-like C

uncertainties: The first three lines may contain W occurrences previously conflated with Z or S.
Paired D strokes and paired CE curves may be compound characters or nulls; neither interpretation is established.
Some A and + instances may have been misclassified.
Supralinear insertion at line 7 remains untranscribed; no text is supplied for it.
